name: game-code-review
description: > Reviews game code and AI-agent changes as a forked reviewer and writes a severity-ranked report: frame-rate independence, hot-path allocations, state and resource lifecycle, hallucinated engine APIs and leaked secrets, for Godot, Unity, Unreal and web.
